topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I pace around the small clearing, my hands trembling slightly as I gaze at the box before me. It's rusted, with a patina that speaks of years spent hidden away from the world. I bend down, my fingers hesitant as they trace the edges of the lid. How odd, I think, to find a time capsule here, in this forgotten corner of my backyard. I don’t recall ever burying anything like this. What secrets does it hold? I glance around, half-expecting someone to jump out and shout, "Surprise!" But there’s only the quiet, patient silence of the trees. With a deep breath, I decide to carefully lift the lid, eager to uncover the mysteries of the past.
